name: Amazon

SDE I (L4).dsaDepth: Heavy — coding (Medium), with Leadership Principles in every round
rounds: Virtual loop of 3–5 interviews: coding plus Leadership Principles, including a Bar Raiser
SDE I (L4).notes: Design rounds are usually skipped at L4, though some 2026 loops add one.

rounds: Online assessment and/or technical phone screen
Loop of 4: two coding, one system design, one low-level design or extra coding
Bar Raiser woven into the loop; behavioral questions open most rounds

SDE III (L6).dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — 2 coding rounds, design carries more weight
rounds: Loop of 5: two coding, system design, object-oriented design or project deep-dive, Bar Raiser behavioral
extraTopics: Leadership Principles with 7+ years of examples

Principal (L7).dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — depth in architecture and organisational impact
rounds: Loop centred on system design, technical strategy and leadership; Bar Raiser
Principal (L7).notes: Details for L7+ are not covered by the cited interview guides.
